data.name: Eliar
data.gender_notes: Eliar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ali rah', meaning 'exalted one', 'noble'. The name is often given to those who are seen as having high moral character and noble qualities. It is also used as a term of respect and admiration. The name Eliar carries the meaning “Noble, exalted one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Eliar usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, representing the ideals of nobility, purity, and high moral character.
data.etymology: Eliar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, exalted one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eliar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: إليار
in_arabic.meaning: إسم مشتق من العلياء يعني الرفعة و العلو
in_arabic.long_meaning: إليار هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الرفعة و العلو و الشرف. و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياقات مختلفة. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و رفيعة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ایلیار
in_urdu.meaning: ایلیار کا مطلب ہے عالی شان، بلند مرتبہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایلیار ایک مسلم مرد کا نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے عالی شان، بلند مرتبہ اور شرف۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے و وسیع پیمانے پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق عربی جڑوں سے ہے و اسلامی تقالید میں اس کی خوبصورتی و خوبی کے باعث اس کا انتخاب کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: एलियार
in_hindi.meaning: एलियार का अर्थ है उच्चतम, श्रेष्ठतम
in_hindi.long_meaning: एलियार एक मुस्लिम लड़के का नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है उच्चतम, श्रेष्ठतम और सम्मान। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में विशेष महत्व रखता है और व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है। इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं और इसकी सुंदरता व महत्व के कारण इसे चुना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: ایلیار
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایلیار د مسلمانو پسه نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې نه اخیستل سوی دی. دا نوم د علو او شان معنی لری. دا نوم په افغانستان کې د پښتنو په منځ کې ډیر استعمال کیږي او خاصه اهمیت لري. دا د عربی ریشه لري او د اسلامی پرودیشن کې یې ښکلا او اهیمت له امله غوره کیږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eliar holds a rich cultural significance in Arabic-speaking communities. It is often used as a term of respect and admiration, indicating the high regard in which the person is held by others due to their virtuous qualities and noble character. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is said to have praised those with honorable names, and the name Eliar would certainly fit into that category. The name is an affirmation of the individual's worth and value in the eyes of society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Eliar represents the ideal, exalted state of the human soul as it strives towards its ultimate goal of attaining nearness to the Divine Presence. The Arabic word 'ali signifies exaltation and nobility, and the word rah refers to contentment and ease. Thus, the name Eliar can be understood as a reminder for the person to continually strive towards moral excellence and to find contentment in the inner certainty of their noble character and desires. It is a call for the individual to elevate their understanding of themselves and their place in the universe, to recognize the divine origins of their being and to strive to live up to that noble potential.

historical_references.context: Masudi mentions a certain Ilyas ibn Ahmad al-Fihri, who ruled Egypt as a vassal of the Abbasid caliphate. Ilyas is also referred to as Eliar in some sources.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khaldun, The Muqaddimah, Book 1, Chapter 1: Introduction The name Eliar carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun describes the rule of the Marinids in North Africa and mentions Eliar as a Berber leader who rebelled against the Marinids and established his own dynasty. Eliar is also known as Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Wattas.
